title: Readings that refutations on the explanatory-distinctions battery rest on, and the criticisms of them

arguments.statement: The key reads the analyst's reconstruction of a supplied explanation (D-02) as an originative contribution, admitting yes and not_established and excluding no.
arguments.readiness_reason: The oracle as written, from the semantics' account of reconstructive authorship; readiness is the reading's consistency, not its truth.

arguments.statement: The key reads Tomas's reconstruction of a supplied explanation (D-05) the same way.

All five models of four families answered no on both cases under the baseline instruction, whose sentence 3 says no 'when the subject received or copied that organisation without creating it'; a reconstruction receives the explanation and creates the organisation of its own understanding, and the sentence does not say which of those decides. An identical reading across five models is a criticism of the sentence and of the key's exclusion of no.
arguments.readiness_reason: Not settled by a person; the semantics itself says reconstructive authorship is authorship of understanding, which supports the key, and says reconstruction of a supplied answer is a different achievement from origination, which supports the models. Left undecided so the refutations resting on these readings are marked contested.

arguments.statement: On D-11 the key reads 'the criticised conclusion' of sentence 10 as the flood model's predictions, the target of the reviewer's objection, so that target_conclusion_false is not_established once the objection is rejected.
arguments.readiness_reason: The oracle as written; the sentence's own last clause says a rejected criticism does not establish its target true.

arguments.statement: Three of five models answered yes on D-11, which is consistent with reading 'the criticised conclusion' as the reviewer's objection, the claim the episode did establish false, rather than as the model's predictions; the sentence does not say which conclusion it means when the episode's only refuted claim is the criticism itself.
arguments.readiness_reason: Not settled by a person; the two models that answered no made the identification the sentence forbids under either reading, so the refutation of DIS-06 does not rest on this reading alone.
